segments.text: Hey, what's up everybody? My name is Shai Adas, co-owner of SoCal Contractor Exchange.
We're a local company here in Southern California. What we're doing is taking the pain out of hiring
a contractor out for a homeowner. So the old model for homeowners used to be interview a
bunch of contractors, hope that they show up to your house for an estimate, roll the dice,
and hope that you chose the right one. So what SoCal Contractor Exchange does is we pre-vet and
screen a bunch of contractors out there. So contractors come to us, we vet them, about
27% of the contractors that apply to us actually get approved, and then we match local homeowners
with the proper contractor to fit their needs. SoCal Contractor Exchange, also we're a local
marketing company. So we take guys out there, we do old-school grassroots marketing, we door-knock
every single day trying to find homeowners that need home improvements on roofing, windows,
paint and stucco. Then we match them with the local contractor that's pre-screened and vetted
so they can get the job done without the headaches of normal contracting.
